summary: The Backrooms is a persistent multiplayer survival RPG across authored maze levels, player-specific rooms, and shared destinations such as the Bonus Room mall. `templates/player.js` composes player behaviors; place simulations and scenes provide local environments, while shared systems own combat, NPCs, loot, building, dialogue, avatar presentation, stealth, and quests. The player journal tracks up to three quests, while the Level 1 Dina camp introduces the live first step of The Undelivered.

migrationNotes: Bonus Room uses shared room/place bonus; soloRoom(userId) names each player's Backrooms room and overflow mall rooms use bonus-N IDs. Teleport Station travel derives from savePlace; level01 is named in hub/feed data and is not a solo home.
Found-item rarity gates apply only to found weapon tokens; existing weapon ownership/use and non-weapon loot are not level-gated. Search gating excludes storage and NPC containers.
